audience.programmeDescription: Religious Studies at the University of Amsterdam studies religious diversity, traditions, texts and practices through historical, literary and social-scientific approaches. The programme gives particular attention to contemporary religion and spirituality, Western esotericism and research in Amsterdam. This example includes the first-year Arabic package.
audience.comparisonExplanation: UCR offers substantial related study in comparative myth, religious art and material culture, ancient ritual, philosophy, social inquiry and religious freedom. These connections do not develop into sustained study of religious traditions, sacred interpretation or contemporary religious practice across a full programme. The wider course combinations shift towards general cultural, philosophical or social study.

componentNotes.rel-116116156y: The first year also requires a Dutch writing diagnostic. Tutoring and study guidance continue throughout the degree. These requirements carry no credits.
componentNotes.rel-121111056y: This example uses the 24 EC first-year Arabic package. Students choose one package in another discipline; this does not create a separate graduation track.
componentNotes.rel-121111066y: Attend Arabic 1 before Arabic 2. Pass both courses before starting Arabic 3 and 4.
componentNotes.rel-121111086y: Attend Arabic 3 before starting Arabic 4. The sequence develops Egyptian Arabic and then Modern Standard Arabic.
componentNotes.rel-116221056y: Post-first-year courses require a positive binding study recommendation. The ordinary full-time threshold is 48 first-year EC. Complete Secrets of the West 1 before 2, and both before the research project.
componentNotes.rel-116221116y: Complete Concepts and Theories before Lived Religion, and both before the Netherlands research project. Students use qualitative methods to investigate contemporary religious practice.
componentNotes.rel-approved-free-profiling-space: Use this 30 EC for electives, a minor, an approved exchange or a placement. Normally no more than 12 EC may be introductory; an approved UvA minor or a same-language sequence can permit up to 24 EC. External study requires Examination Board approval. A placement may occupy up to 12 EC; the Religious Studies and Western Esotericism minors cannot duplicate the compulsory curriculum.
componentNotes.rel-116221216y: Complete the first year and all compulsory second-year courses before starting. Register for the thesis at the same time. A supervisor must approve the research plan before the first thesis section is written.
componentNotes.rel-116219012y: The 12 EC thesis follows the 6 EC research project. Complete the first year and compulsory second-year courses, and pass the research project before the thesis can be assessed.
